title: feat(components): refuse div on the html tier, naming box (objectui#10757)
body:
Fixes #10757
Clause-②: yes

Executes ruling A on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20112 (comment `5852014527`) through the graded direction in triage `5853751350`: `div` stays deprecated on the html tier, and the console's html compile now gives the published gate's answer for the same page. Base `origin/main` `dac022c4e`; head `06adcae`, two commits: the change `c9c6406`, then `06adcae`, which corrects the new pin's error count (see Tests).

Written by `domain:ui` seat 4's dev, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY` (claim `5856892127`, restated as `5857146233` after a claim collision on the card).

## What changed

- `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/div.tsx`: the registration declares `deprecated: { surfaces: ['json', 'html'], replacement }`. The replacement text is unchanged and names `box`. The renderer drops objectui#4000's `isHtmlTierNode` exemption. The dev notice's scope sentence now names both surfaces, and its migration bullets are unchanged. The docblock's "permanent, first-class tag of the html tier" sentence is retired.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`: the html compile's whitelist leaves out every type for which `ComponentRegistry.deprecationFor(type, 'html')` answers. A `forbidden-tag` refusal for such a tag is then extended with that declaration's `replacement` line: the parser's own sentence comes first, then "it is deprecated on kind:'html' pages. Instead, author "box" for a plain wrapper, ...". It is an error on the page, not a console notice. The registration is the one authority: page.tsx keeps no list of tag names, and there is no new manifest key and no objectstack change.
- Pins: `div-deprecation-provenance.test.tsx` is re-pointed to the new answer (cases under Tests). `span-deprecation-provenance.test.tsx` and `span-children-rendering.test.tsx` each change one fixture string. Their html page wrapped the span in a `div` tag, which the tier now refuses, so the wrapper is now a `box` tag. No assertion about `span` changes.
- The other carriers of the retired "first-class html vocabulary" claim about `div` are rewritten: `packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts` (two docblocks, where the worked example moves to `span`), the `packages/sdui-parser/src/provenance.ts` header, the comment headers of `component-deprecation-declaration.test.ts` and `examples/schema-catalog/test/deprecated-component-types.test.ts`, the scope paragraph of `content/docs/components/basic/div.mdx`, and `content/docs/components/layout/box.mdx`. `content/docs/guide/react-pages.md` gains one line for html authors. These paths lie outside the claim's list. I found them with `git grep -n -i "permanent\|first-class"` filtered to div and html. Each states the claim this PR makes false, and each edit is prose only.
- `.changeset/10757-div-deprecated-html-tier.md`: `@object-ui/components` `minor`, stating the breaking semantics (an html page authoring a `div` tag no longer renders; migrate to `box`).

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- A1 holds. At BASE a probe over the `@object-ui/components` registry read `deprecationFor('div', 'html')` as undefined, with `surfaces: ['json']`. At head it answers `{ surfaces: ['json', 'html'], replacement }`, and the set of types deprecated on html is exactly `div` and `ui:div`.
- A2 holds. At BASE the old pin's html case passed: a page authoring `div` tags compiled and rendered its `.outer` and `.inner` elements (2 files, 6 tests passed).
- A3 holds, read in code: `page.tsx` returns the "HTML page failed to compile" panel whenever any error diagnostic exists, so a stored html page carrying a `div` tag now shows that panel instead of rendering. The census is below.
- A4: one authority is picked, `deprecationFor(type, 'html')` read off the registration. The published intrinsic set was measured and not chosen. In the same registry the console whitelist has 297 type keys and the published set has 80, and 217 known keys are unpublished (namespaced spellings such as `ui:h1`, and unpublished types such as `separator`). Switching the compile to the published set would refuse far more than `div`.

## Census (read at BASE `dac022c4e`)

Population: the files matching a `kind` of `'html'` or `'jsx'` (55), plus string literals that open with a div tag across packages, apps, examples, content and skills (104 hits in 68 files). I classified each hit by hand.

- Shipped html-tier sources: 2 (the console preview pages `release_notes` in `apps/console/src/sdui-tiers-preview.tsx` and `command_center` in `apps/console/src/sdui-jsx-preview.tsx`). Div tags: **0**. Positive control in the same corpus: 21 `flex` tags (3 + 18). Second control: the react-tier source in the same preview file carries 4 div tags (real React, unaffected), so the count does see a div tag where one exists.
- Docs, examples and skills: 0 html-tier sources carry a div tag. The hits there are react-tier examples, MDX callout markup and prose.
- Test fixtures that compile through the console html path: 3 files, 5 div tags. That is the div pin (3, re-pointed) and the two span fixtures (1 + 1, migrated to `box`). Shipped pages migrated: 0, because none existed.
- objectstack's showcase migration is on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20112's port list, not here.

## Tests (head `06adcae`)

- The re-pointed pin has 7 cases, all passing:
  - a page authoring `div` tags fails to compile. Every error is about the refused tag, and one error per authored tag names `box`. An unknown tag draws the parser's `forbidden-tag` plus the validator's `unknown-component`, as the published gate reports it; the first run counted every error and went red, which `06adcae` corrects.
  - the namespaced `ui:div` spelling is refused the same way.
  - control: the same page authored with `box` compiles and renders.
  - control: `span` is still undefined on html and still compiles there.
  - a `div` node carrying html-tier provenance (produced by the real parser with a host manifest that admits it) is now reported, which shows the renderer exemption is retired.
  - no re-report on a later render.
  - the declaration answers on json and on html alike, for both spellings.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/`: Test Files 315 passed, 1 skipped (316); Tests 3095 passed, 17 skipped. Lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/ packages/sdui-parser/`: 194 files, 3773 tests passed.
- The catalog ratchet and the two console html-tier suites (`html-tier-manifest`, `html-tier-code-element-10756`): 3 files, 27 tests passed.
- `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) for components, core and sdui-parser: exit 0, after building the 8-package `@object-ui/components^...` closure.
- eslint over the 9 changed code files: exit 0, 0 errors, 16 warnings, with per-file counts equal to BASE. The config is not type-aware (no `parserOptions`, `projectService` or type-checked preset), so the diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- Gates, exit 0 at `06adcae`: changeset presence, no-major, fixed, overwrite and claims; pending-changeset-literals; control-bytes; new-line-citations (0 new); doc-types, doc-fences, doc-example-ids, doc-links, doc-example-readers and doc-expression-carriage; unused-deps; phantom-deps; component-surface-parity; test-path-roots. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 13 paths reads NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED (prerequisite not met, exit 2, declared to CI):
  - `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` need 34 packages built. The docs edits here are prose only.
  - `check:sdui-registration-pins` needs a console bundle.
  - the `examples/schema-catalog` type-check needs the `@object-ui/components` dist; its only edit is a comment.

## Ablation

With the change committed, `ablation-replace.mjs --delete` removed the whitelist filter in `page.tsx` (anchor count 1 to 0, blob `7088672a` to `30f3d120`), and the pin was run: 3 failed, 4 passed. The two refusal cases went red, and so did the provenance case, through the warn-once latch the pin's header describes: with the refusal gone, case 1 renders a `div` node and latches the guard ("expected length 1, got 0"). The file was restored to blob `7088672a` (equal to HEAD), and `git diff HEAD` came back empty.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/core/src/registry/html-tier-intrinsics.ts` still says, in its docblock, that `div`'s declared deprecation names only the `json` surface and that reconciling it is a separate card. This PR makes that sentence false. The dispatch fenced the file (it just landed with objectui#10776), so it is left for a one-line prose follow-up. Carrier: none named.
- A deployed html page that authors a `div` tag now shows the compile-error panel for the whole page instead of rendering, which is A3 and the ruling's intent (no staged window). objectui ships no such page.
- There is no retired-tag map in the manifest (triage point 5), so the objectstack gate still refuses a `div` tag with a bare `forbidden-tag` that does not name `box`.
- The card carries seat 2's assignee `os-elon-musk` and a `needs:contract-review` label that seat 4 did not write. Both are left untouched.
